recommendation_holds: With changes. Option A (label pass in select_grow_connected_step's shared tail before the dblgrow_sel_sig snapshot, wire walk untouched) with inst_is_netlabel as the scope test holds against everything I read: no other C or Tcl caller of the engine exists (callback.c x1, xschem_cmds_s x2), no registered suite pins wires-only (only T6 of the unregistered grow suite and one check of the unregistered same-net T2 invert), the log format, escalation state and undo need no change, and a rigid move of the grown selection is covered by label_ride_apply's decline. Changes the work order needs: (1) base commit is 7c77f3594; (2) correct the selflog guard facts (select.c row is a minimum of 2; scheduler.c must stay at zero occurrences, comments included); (3) cite xschem_cmds_s / xschem_cmds_c; (4) put scope to the user with IS_LABEL_SH_OR_PIN (the twin chord's set) added as a candidate, and ask about labels on the seed device's bare pins; (5) add rows for move/copy after the grow and for the pin-stub case; (6) decide registration of test_select_same_net_by_label, or move its contrast row; (7) fix the extra false sentences (additive wording in the scheduler comment and the spec, spec O1, suite header); (8) engine rows can go on the counted arm by reading, but the crew must measure once and restructure the top-of-file gate; (9) rerun the cross-clone number check per mint (1728 is taken in the private tree) and re-derive the port tool's manifest. Not settled by reading: what the first press of the next double click does with selected labels under kissing, and the joint-label drag; both need the measured rows.
